basis: The 'Units Sold by Product (Weekend Pop-up)' chart (chart_1) shows a linear vertical axis with labeled ticks at 20,000 and 30,000 units. The bar labeled 'Product C' has a top edge positioned between these two ticks, specifically below the visual midpoint (25,000 units). This places the Product C value in the range of approximately 24,000 units. According to the 'Merchandising policy levels' table, a unit condition of '< 25,000 units' triggers the 'Low-demand review queue activation level'. While the value is also within 2,500 units of the threshold (potentially triggering the 'Manual merchandising verification variance band'), the 'Open Product C low-demand review' option directly corresponds to the primary activation level for values under 25,000.
